Verify [SHA256SUMS.txt](SHA256SUMS.txt). Historical installers are retained. Build 8 adds multiple wallet requests, genuine watch-only transfers, exact address labels and vault monitoring, and locally approved recovery with existing pruning settings unchanged throughout.

Dashboard V1 Build 9 supports the older Build 7 preview flow. Build 8's queue, version-2 public previews and recovery results require the [Dashboard handoff update](../DASHBOARD_BUILD8_UPDATE.md). Dashboard source is unchanged here.

Read the [signing audit warning and build details](../README.md) and [validation limits](../VALIDATION.md) before use. Development only; Stable is unchanged.
